noInherit.description: If true, the annotation is not inherited by mixins.

name.description: name of the KvStore.FileSystem.Config to look up for rootUrl & other properties

tableField.description:
name of the table field in the type which will be used to append table name to rootUrl. If specified will be
appended to the rootUrl before partitionKey & after {@link KvStore.FileSystem.Config#rootUrl}

partitionKeyField.description: name of the partition key field in the type which will be used to append partition key to rootUrl

fileSpec.description: File operation specification to use for reading from the file system

title: Annotation for specifying the file system configuration for dynamically reading from it
name: Ann.KvFs
